DiPlay is the direct upstream of GalaxyPlay, providing the CarPlay protocol, connection, authentication and media receiver core. GalaxyPlay uses the official release as its baseline and maintains its own interface, configuration and head-unit adaptations for Galaxy L6 and L7.
